messages:
incident-bot: Pager — tenant=echidna-prod (VPC: us-east-1). Elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency. Error-rate 28% (5m). Affected route: /api/generate (model variant: triton-13b-q4). Severity P2. Paging @oncall-evan.
oncall-evan: Acknowledged. Joining now, pulling logs and metrics.
support-jules: Customer ticket #78912 — user checkouts timing out, started ~10:12 UTC, ~30% of requests fail with 502 from our gateway. No direct application errors from their side.
sre-ana: Seeing a correlation with high KV cache miss rate and a spike in token-queue waits on the dedicated pool serving echidna-prod. CPU on host-gpu-07 spiked ~3x.
eng-runtime-mike: Checking model runtime logs — OOM-ish eviction traces for the active variant. Looks like sequence-length distribution spiked due to a customer-side batch of long prompts.
support-jules: Customer confirms they rolled out a large batch job at 10:05 that increased long-context calls.
eng-runtime-mike: Immediate mitigation: route echidna-prod to a safe, lower-memory variant and pin tenant to safe variant until we stabilize. Recommend safe-variant id: echo-safe-v1 (quantized, smaller context footprint). Also suggest shifting traffic to dedicated-us-east-2 pool with spare capacity.
solutions-lin: +1 on pin. We should also notify the customer success lead (Rita) before switching routing for visibility.
customer-success-rita: Saw ticket, on a quick call with customer now. They prefer a short outage window over degraded responses. If we pin to safe variant, ask if any fidelity regressions are acceptable — they confirmed yes for immediate mitigation.
oncall-evan: I'll enact a temporary pin and route change. Will do a 5% canary to start.
eng-runtime-mike: Command to pin & route (run from ops-admin):
```
curl -X POST 'https://control.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/echidna-prod/overrides' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"override_type":"model_pin","model_id":"echo-safe-v1","percentage":5,"routing_target":"dedicated-us-east-2"}'
```
eng-runtime-mike: That creates a transient override. If 5% canary looks good after 2m, we can escalate to 100%. Also add KV cache prewarm command:
```
POST /internal/cache/warm?tenant=echidna-prod&variant=echo-safe-v1
body: {"seed_prompts":["<common-prefix-1>","<checkout-flow>"]}
```
sre-ana: Initiating canary now. Watching error-rate, p95, and tokens/sec.
incident-bot: Canary applied by oncall-evan at 10:28:12 UTC — 5% traffic -> echo-safe-v1 @ dedicated-us-east-2.
sre-ana: Initial 2m look: error-rate dropped from 28% -> 6% on canary, p95 down to 350ms. Good signs.
oncall-evan: Customer on call confirms reduced failures for users hitting canary path.
eng-runtime-mike: Proceeding to promote to 100% route. Running override update now.
eng-runtime-mike: Promotion command (ops-admin):
```
curl -X POST 'https://control.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/echidna-prod/overrides' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"override_type":"model_pin","model_id":"echo-safe-v1","percentage":100,"routing_target":"dedicated-us-east-2","note":"auto-mitigate-long-context OOMs"}'
```
incident-bot: Override applied at 10:33:05 UTC by eng-runtime-mike.
sre-ana: Full traffic routed. Monitoring heatmap for evictions and queue depth — both are normalizing.
support-jules: Updated ticket #78912: "We've routed you to a safe runtime variant; we expect normal behavior within a few minutes. CS lead will follow up on fidelity tradeoffs."
customer-success-rita: Customer accepted temporary variant; asking for ETA on permanent fix (we should own a follow-up).
eng-runtime-mike: Next actions: 1) Investigate sequence-length detection and proactive throttling/guardrails for tenant-side batch ops. 2) Evaluate auto-fallback to safe variants when eviction rates cross threshold. 3) Postmortem and a fix to KV cache warmup behavior. I'll open an RFC.
sre-ana: I'll document the live mitigations and add them to the Echidna oncall runbook (include commands used).
oncall-evan: Handoff: I'm going offline at 11:00 UTC. @sre-ana please take the incident lead for next 6 hours.
sre-ana: Taking lead. Will keep monitoring and escalate to eng-runtime if we see regression.
incident-bot: Incident transitioned to monitoring state at 10:41:20 UTC. Severity downgraded to P3.
support-jules: Closing interim customer comms loop. Will send a short summary to the customer and schedule follow-up next week. :white_check_mark:
customer-success-rita: Noted. I'll sync with product to decide permanent model policy for echidna-prod (pin vs. adaptive fallbacks).
oncall-evan: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
